checks.name: Default semantics
checks.evidence: Gateway omitted/blank sector defaults All; frontend first option All and request fallback All. Explicit Unknown remains a distinct filtered classification.

checks.name: Exclusive buyer classification
checks.evidence: Ordered CASE classifies Government first, then Internal, then territory/private markers, then Unknown. A Government/Internal source area with a territory marker does not enter Private. All intentionally applies no sector restriction.

checks.name: Closed historical months
checks.evidence: Bounds and product aggregation both use Manila current-month exclusive upper boundary; stable tie ordering retained. Rollover cases tested.

checks.name: Strict numerical inputs and identity
checks.evidence: Blank/null/Boolean/missing inputs fail; explicit zero preserved. Integer fields require safe integer values. Unique exhaustive exact shortlist products and stale checksum enforced; malformed POST scope uses gateway error class.

checks.name: Currency arithmetic
checks.evidence: Exact decimal/exponent cents conversion rejects nonzero fractional cents, including high-precision strings. Supported amount/cents bounds safe; infeasible minimum costs compared before multiplication; successful spend derived from integer cents.

checks.name: Iteration exhaustion
checks.evidence: If affordable candidates remain after100000 iterations, status not_solved with conflicts and empty rows. Exact boundary completion succeeds. Frontend already exposes every nonsuccess conflict and keeps allocation result unset.

checks.name: Transport scalar guard
checks.evidence: Global /api middleware precedes planning routes and returns400 INVALID_QUERY_PARAMETER for repeated/structured query values. Route fallback is protected; initial route-only concern retracted.

checks.name: No unsupported decision authority
checks.evidence: Success remains scenario_allocation; assumptions explicitly scenario only, greedy globally nonoptimal disclosure unchanged. No automatic inventory/forecast/product/clinical approval, quantity conversion or order action introduced.
